# Appropriation Ordinance No. 01, Series of 2009

**Appropriation Ordinance No. 01**

## Summary

An appropriation ordinance enacting the Pre-Closing Special Budget of the [[Municipality of Pitogo]] for the fiscal year ending December 31, 2008. At the close of business on December 31, 2008, there was a savings of Three Hundred Fifty Three Thousand Four Hundred Ninety Pesos and 56/100 (P 353,490.56) and an overdraft in appropriation in the amount of Three Hundred Fifty Three Thousand Four Hundred Ninety Pesos and 56/100 (P 353,490.56). The ordinance appropriates funds to cover the overdraft to make the expenditures for FY 2008 proper and legal.

**Total savings at close of business (Dec 31, 2008):** P 353,490.56
**Total overdraft in appropriation:** P 353,490.56

## Key Provisions

- **Section 1.** At the close of business on December 31, 2008, there is a savings of Three Hundred Fifty Three Thousand Four Hundred Ninety Pesos and 56/100 (P 353,490.56) and an overdraft in appropriation in the amount of Three Hundred Fifty Three Thousand Four Hundred Ninety Pesos and 56/100 (P 353,490.56).
- **Section 2.** The amount of Three Hundred Fifty Three Thousand Four Hundred Ninety Pesos and 56/100 (P 353,490.56) is hereby appropriated to cover up overdraft in appropriation in the amount of Three Hundred Fifty Three Thousand Four Hundred Ninety Pesos and 56/100 (P 353,490.56) to make the expenditures for the year 2008 proper and legal.
- **Section 3.** The Pre-Closing Special Budget prepared by the Municipal Budget Officer is hereby attached and made as integral part of this ordinance and marked as "Annex A".
